name: terminal-manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd();after=json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text());assert after.get('mismatches')==[]
excluded=['byte-manifest.json','terminal-manifest.receipt.json','terminal-manifest.output.txt']
rows=[]
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 rel=str(p.relative_to(lane))
 if rel in excluded:continue
 b=p.read_bytes();rows.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
manifest={'kind':'actual terminal own-lane SHA256 byte manifest','files':rows,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':{'byte-manifest.json':'manifest cannot contain its own digest','terminal-manifest.receipt.json':'runner creates this receipt only after this child ends; including it would create a terminal circular dependency','terminal-manifest.output.txt':'runner creates this output only after child ends and it contains manifest digest'},'coverage':'Every existing own-lane file except the three named terminal self-exclusions, including every other completed receiptJSON, helpers, plans, original raw/token/decoded data, successful guard outcomes/hashchain, search responses, frozen-before/after, all inventories and handoff files','frozen_after':'13 inputs checked, no mismatches; no frozen writes after verification'}
s=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'byte-manifest.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
for row in rows:
 b=(lane/row['path']).read_bytes();assert len(b)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(rows),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('byte-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'all_entries_verified':True,'frozen_count':13,'mismatches':[],'qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0,'terminal_self_exclusions':excluded}))
